senses.sense_definition: The name of various rivers in China.

examples.text: The <w>Song</w> River flows through several provinces in the eastern part of the country.

target_lang_translations.tr: <w>Song</w> Nehri, ülkenin doğu kesimindeki birkaç eyaletten geçmektedir.
target_lang_translations.es: El río <w>Song</w> fluye a través de varias provincias en la parte oriental del país.
target_lang_translations.zh: <w>松花江</w>流经该国东部的几个省份。

examples.text: Local legends often mention the spirits living in the <w>Song</w> waters.
